candidate_windows.window_text: In this section, we first introduce the problem formulation of the QA task enhanced by intermediate CoT reasoning in Section 3.1. Then, we present the procedure of LongFinanceQA dataset construction in Section 3.2. After that, we describe the fine-tuning details in Section 3.3.

Evaluation Benchmarks. We evaluate longcontext understanding using two practical benchmarks:Loong (Wang et al.， 2024） and $\infty$ Bench (Zhang et al.， 2024b). Loong focuses on real-world multi-document question ans wering and comprises 1,6OO test samples across four categories, including Spotlight Locating, Comparison, Clustering,and Chain of Reasoning. These tasks assess distinct capabilities in handling longcontext tasks. ooBench facilitates multilingual evaluation, assessing models on English (En.QA) and Chinese (Zh.QA) question-answering tasks that require long-range dependency and reasoning beyond short-passage retrieval.

Evaluation Metrics. For evaluation, Loong employs GPT-4-Turbo as a judge, scoring model responses based on accuracy, hallucinations,and completeness on a scale of O to 1Oo.Meanwhile, it introduces the Perfect Rate, measuring the proportion of responses achieving a perfect score. In Bench, model performance is measured by the F1 score (Zhang et al., 2024b).

Base Models. We adopt GPT-4o-mini (Achiam et al., 2023) and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct (Dubey et al.,2024) as our base models. Specifically, GPT-4o-mini serves as the agent of the proposed Property-based Agentic Inference (PAI),while LLaMA-3.1-8B is used as the base model for LongPAI, which is fine-tuned on the LongFinanceQA.

Implementation Details. To enable training on long sequences $( > 2 5 0 \mathrm { K } )$ ,we employ several optimization techniques, including flash-attention2 (Dao,2023) and ring-attention (Liu et al., 2024c). Furthermore, we adopt a zigzag sharding approach (Zhu, 2024) within ring attention for more effective load distribution across multiple GPUs. This training setup allows us to fine-tune the large language models fully. Using 8 A1OO GPUs, the long-context training is completed in three days for fine-tuning. In addition,in training the longcontext LLMs, we adopt the rotary base scaling approach (Liu et al., 2O24d) and scale up the base value (i.e., rotary base of 1,247,820) to adapt RoPE to a longer context. For optimization,we use a constant learning rate of le-5 for the entire training procedure. Following the common practice (Fu et al., 2024),we set the batch size to 16M tokens as mentioned in (Dubey et al., 2O24). During inference,we set the temperature as zero to eliminate the randomness.We also increase the maximum output tokens to 1,024 since the CoT reasoning requires more output tokens.
